description: This file defines Express routes for handling CRUD operations and detailed API endpoints related to 'projects'. It includes endpoints for project overview, usage totals, and per-user usage, leveraging services for analytics and database models for project and tenant data.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing projects, using a CRUD controller.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET request for fetching a project by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project.

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/overview')
methods.description: Provides detailed overview of a specific project, including ownership info, user costs, session durations, and credits usage.

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/usage')
methods.description: Returns aggregated credits used and total costs for a specific project.

methods.name: router.get('/:projectId/users/usage')
methods.description: Provides per-user usage data, including costs and time, for a specific project.
